create_app.description: Create an app with the specified details in the request body.
create_app.name: create_app

parameters.description: Request a wildcard TLS certificate for *.svc. .fly.dev. Defaults to false. Certificate provisioning is asynchronous; this does not create services or configure their routing.
parameters.name: enable_subdomains

parameters.description:
When set, makes a retry of this exact request safe: a
second create with the same key and the same name (or no name) returns
the app the first request created, instead of erroring on a false name
conflict or creating a duplicate. A second create with the same key
but a *different* name is rejected outright; it won't silently
hand back the first app.
parameters.name: idempotency_key

parameters.description: Globally unique name for the app. Required.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Name of the organization's private network to attach the app to. Creates the network if it does not exist. Omit, use an empty string, or use "default" to select the organization's default network.
parameters.name: network

parameters.description: Slug of the organization that will own the app, or "personal" for your personal organization. Required.
parameters.name: org_slug

delete_app.description: Delete an app by its name.
delete_app.name: delete_app

get_app.description: Retrieve details about a specific app by its name.
get_app.name: get_app

get_machine.description: Get details of a specific Machine within an app by the Machine ID.
get_machine.name: get_machine

parameters.description: 26-character Machine version ID; returns that version of the Machine instead of the current one
parameters.name: version

auto_destroy.description: Optional boolean telling the Machine to destroy itself once it’s complete (default false)

checks.description: An optional object that defines one or more named top-level checks. The key for each check is the check name.

containers.description: Containers are a list of containers that will run in the machine, each from its own image.

cmd.description: CmdOverride is used to override the default command of the image.

depends_on.description:
DependsOn can be used to define dependencies between containers. The container will only be
started after all of its dependent conditions have been satisfied.

entrypoint.description: EntrypointOverride is used to override the default entrypoint of the image.

env.description: ExtraEnv is used to add additional environment variables to the container.

env_from.description: EnvFrom can be provided to set environment variables from machine fields.

items.description: EnvVar defines an environment variable to be populated from a machine field, env_var

env_var.description:
EnvVar is required and is the name of the environment variable that will be set from the
secret. It must be a valid environment variable name.

field_ref.description: FieldRef selects a field of the Machine: supports id, version, app_name, private_ip, region, image.

exec.description:
Image Config overrides - these fields are used to override the image configuration.
If not provided, the image configuration will be used.
ExecOverride is used to override the default command of the image.

files.description: Files are files that will be written to the container file system.

items.description: A file that will be written to the Machine. One of RawValue or SecretName must be set.

guest_path.description:
GuestPath is the path on the machine where the file will be written and must be an absolute path.
For example: /full/path/to/file.json

image_config.description: The name of an image to use the OCI image config as the file contents.

mode.description: Mode bits used to set permissions on this file as accepted by chmod(2).

secret_name.description: The name of the secret that contains the base64 encoded file contents.

failure_threshold.description: The number of times the check must fail before considering the container unhealthy.

grace_period.description: The time in seconds to wait after a container starts before checking its health.

headers.description: Additional headers to send with the request

method.description: The HTTP method to use to when making the request

path.description: The path to send the request to

port.description: The port to connect to, often the same as internal_port

tls_server_name.description: If the protocol is https, the hostname to use for TLS certificate validation

tls_skip_verify.description: If the protocol is https, whether or not to verify the TLS certificate

interval.description: The time in seconds between executing the defined check.

name.description: The name of the check. Must be unique within the container.

name.description: Name is used to identify the container in the machine.

max_retries.description: When policy is on-failure, the maximum number of times to attempt to restart the Machine before letting it stop.

policy.description:
* no - Never try to restart a Machine automatically when its main process exits, whether that’s on purpose or on a crash.
* always - Always restart a Machine automatically and never let it enter a stopped state, even when the main process exits cleanly.
* on-failure - Try up to MaxRetries times to automatically restart the Machine if it exits with a non-zero exit code. Default when no explicit policy is set, and for Machines with schedules.

get_machine_lease.name: get_machine_lease

description.description: Description or reason for the Lease.

nonce.description: Nonce is the unique ID autogenerated and associated with the Lease.

list_apps.description: List all apps with the ability to filter by organization slug.
list_apps.name: list_apps

parameters.description: The org slug, or 'personal', to filter apps
parameters.name: org_slug

parameters.description: The number of apps to fetch (must be between 1 and 5000). Providing a limit enables pagination. Without it, all apps are returned in one response.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Value of next_cursor from the previous page. Requires limit. Later pages only include apps that existed when the first page was requested. Apps created in the seconds before the first page was requested may be missing. Cursors expire 30 minutes after the first page was requested.
parameters.name: cursor

next_cursor.description:
Pagination cursor for the next page. Absent when no more apps remain.
Cursors expire 30 minutes after the first page was requested.

total_apps.description:
The number of apps matching the request, across all pages. When
paginating, it is counted once when the first page is requested and not
updated afterwards, so it may differ slightly from the number of apps
returned: it excludes apps created later and includes apps deleted while
paginating. Apps created in the seconds before the first page may also be
counted but missing from the pages.

parameters.description: Number of results per page (default 25, max 500)
parameters.name: limit

list_machine_events.description: List all events associated with a specific Machine within an app.
list_machine_events.name: list_machine_events

parameters.description: The number of events to fetch (max of 50). If omitted, this is set to 20 by default.
parameters.name: limit

list_machine_processes.description: List all processes running on a specific Machine within an app, with optional sorting parameters.

list_machine_versions.description: List all versions of the configuration for a specific Machine within an app.
list_machine_versions.name: list_machine_versions

fly_io_new_volume_trigger.description: Runs for each new volume in Fly.io. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields attached_alloc_id, attached_machine_id, auto_backup_enabled, block_size, blocks, blocks_avail, blocks_free, bytes_total, bytes_used, created_at, encrypted, fstype, host_features, host_status, id, name, region, required_host_features, size_gb, snapshot_retention, state, type, zone
